task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the right arm to move the playingcards pack with blue top to the left of the sleek black-faced smartphone.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用右手臂将蓝色顶部的扑克牌包移动到时尚黑面智能手机的左侧。
